intro: This quest marks the culmination of the assault against Blackwing Lair, tasking champions with returning the severed head of Nefarian to Orgrimmar. Bringing the monstrous trophy to Warchief Thrall secures proof that the brood of the Black Dragonflight has been broken. It is a moment of monumental triumph for the Horde against one of their most insidious enemies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Warchief, champion.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I wish that I could have been there to see the look on the face of the beast as you struck the killing blow, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have honored the Horde once more, friend. The son of Deathwing lays dead. Surely, the evil one stirs.
